title: Add a Postgres db package on Prisma

directory.description: The project root of the db package, for example packages/db.
directory.x-prompt: Which directory gets the db package?

backend.description: The project root of a node-app that connects to the database before it serves, for example apps/backend.

port.description: The host port of the local Postgres in compose.dev.yml. Two repos whose stacks run at once need two ports.
